scope.label: On the final
scope.covers: Lectures 01 to 10 were Exam 1. The final is cumulative, so all of this comes back, and the questions below are the ones he already asked about it.
scope.evidence: On Exam 1, about 15 of the 25 questions came almost word for word from the review sheet, with only the sounds, numbers or positions changed. The topics marked Asked on Exam 1 had a question on the exam. The topics marked On the review sheet were on the review but not the exam. Questions marked Predicted change one thing in a real review or exam question. They are predictions, not confirmed exam questions.

flags: The Exam 1 key is the professor's own. Where an answer here says more than the key, the extra sentences are the slides' explanation of the same answer, not a different answer.
The uploaded answer companion for the review sheet has unverified authorship. Its answers agree with the slides, and nothing here comes only from it.
The deck labeled Lectures 05–06 has the internal title Lectures 4+5. Both labels mean the same deck.

Lecture 08 page 10 and page 9 show two Euler methods. The explicit method uses the old position and the old velocity for both updates, and its swings grow. The position-first method uses the new position for the velocity update, and its swings stay the same size. The slides show both so that you can see the order of the updates matters.
